title: NGINX HTTP/2 event: scope of the other CVEs
what_changed: Per nginx.org advisories, CVE-2026-123634 is a medium use-after-free in the resolver (not HTTP/2) and CVE-2026-121810 a medium use-after-free in HTTP/3; CVE-2026-113425 is in the mail proxy module. Summary, action, key findings and recommendations now say disabling HTTP/2 covers only the HTTP/2 flaws (CVE-2026-123633, CVE-2026-123007). nginx.org added as a source.
